items.evidence: Each category contains multiple performance measures
several notable successes in capital management
strong operating performance on measures of key importance
Earnings —2017 reported earnings of $9.2 billion and $4.85 EPS exceeded Plan.
Net cash flow —Chevron delivered positive cash flow in 2017, driven by actions taken to selectively sell assets
Divestiture proceeds —$5.2 billion in asset sales proceeds were realized for the year.
Return on capital employed —Reported ROCE for 2017 of 5.0 percent exceeded Plan.
Capital and exploratory expenditures—2017 C&E totaled $18.8 billion, $1.0 billion, or 5 percent, lower than budget
Net production of 2.755 million barrels of oil-equivalent per day in 2017, excluding divestments.
Operating expenses and selling, general and administrative expenses totaled $23.9 billion, better than Plan
Refining unit utilization rates below Plan, primarily due to unplanned shutdowns
Maintained industry-leading personal safety rates, better than the Plan on several measures
Loss of containment performance was better than Plan; spill volume above Plan.
The MCC continues to believe that TSR is the best overall pay-for-performance measure
Stock Options | 25% | • Strike price is equal to the closing common stock price on the grant date.
Five-year cliff vesting lengthens equity holding time, which enhances retention and alignment with stockholders.
